title: Backpack Secures Major US Exchange Approval, Native Token Soars 20%
summary: Backpack, a crypto-focused financial platform, has received approval from the CFTC to establish a regulated derivatives exchange and clearinghouse. This will allow it to bring cryptocurrency perpetual futures trading to the American market, and the announcement sent its native BP token up 20% in 24 hours.
